# Norman Douglas

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P27](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0027)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP P38](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0038), [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P0](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0000)</sub>
- **Family:** [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Norman Douglas was once a handsome young giant, and he remains a big man with a massive head. He features a high, white, unwrinkled forehead and blue eyes capable of flashing with fire. He possesses an ungrizzled mane of red hair alongside a long, ruddy red beard that sweeps over his broad chest.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P28](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0028), [v5 CHAPTER XXI. THE IMPOSSIBLE WORD P15](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0015), [v5 CHAPTER XXII. ST. GEORGE KNOWS ALL ABOUT IT P1](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER XXXII. TWO STUBBORN PEOPLE P2](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0002)_

## Personality

Norman Douglas is a big, clever, and well-read man known for his bracing, stimulating, and loud presence. In his youth, he was a handsome, red-haired young giant noted for his wild driving and noisy, harmless escapades. While he possesses a genial, whirlwind nature, he also displays a complacent attitude, a sharp temper, and a tendency toward bullying and coaxing others. Driven by a lifelong determination, his primary motivation is to marry [Ellen West](../character/ellen-west.md).

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P29](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0029), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P87](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0087), [v5 CHAPTER XXI. ## History

Norman Douglas had previously escorted [Ellen West](../character/ellen-west.md) for two years before jilting and leaving her in a fit of temper. In a fit of pique to spite [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md), he married [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) Reese—a decision he repented all his life—and ceased attending church for twenty years. When [Faith Meredith](../character/faith.md) courageously confronted him over his insults, Norman was impressed by her fiery spirit, apologized, and agreed to contribute to the minister's salary and attend services once a month. He later teases [Faith](../character/faith.md) after church and challenges her father's theology. Eventually, Norman confronted Ellen's sister, [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md), at the spring in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), persuading her to release [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) from her past vow so that he and [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) could marry. However, despite [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) releasing her sister, [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) refused to marry Norman if [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) remained living alone on the hill.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP P1](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP P2](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0002), [v5 CHAPTER XV. ## Quotes

> "‘Evening, girl. Sit down again—sit down again. I want to have a talk with you. Bless the girl, what’s she looking at me like that for? I don’t want to eat you—I’ve had my supper. Sit down and be civil."
>
> — Norman Douglas — [v5 CHAPTER XXXII. TWO STUBBORN PEOPLE P4](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0004)

> "So you can, girl, if you use your ears. I only wanted you to be comfortable. You look so durned uncomfortable, standing there. Well, I’ll sit anyway."
>
> — Norman Douglas — [v5 CHAPTER XXXII. TWO STUBBORN PEOPLE P6](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0006)

> "Let’s have a reasonable, sensible, friendly chat. There’s something I want to ask you. Ellen says she won’t, so it’s up to me to do it."
>
> — Norman Douglas — [v5 CHAPTER XXXII. TWO STUBBORN PEOPLE P8](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0008)

> "Well, a bargain is a bargain. I reckon I can stand it twelve times a year. What a sensation it’ll make the first Sunday I go! And old Susan Baker says I’m going to hell, hey? Do you believe I’ll go there—come, now, do you?"
>
> — Norman Douglas — [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P67](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0067)

> "Listen to her. You can’t cuddle a rooster as you can a kitten. Who ever heard of petting a rooster? Better take little Tom. I want to find a good home for him."
>
> — Norman Douglas — [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P83](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0083)

## Relationships

### [Ellen West](../character/ellen-west.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/ellen-west--norman-douglas.md)

Norman and [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) enjoy a spirited rapport, marked by friendly debates such as the one [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) wins at a local gathering. Their desire to marry creates tension surrounding a past promise between [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) and her sister, which initially keeps them apart. Norman becomes betrothed to [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) after taking direct action to clear the obstacle standing in the way of their marriage.

- Romantically involved with — betrothed  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP P31](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0031), [v5 CHAPTER XXI. THE IMPOSSIBLE WORD P15](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0015), [v5 CHAPTER XXII. ST. GEORGE KNOWS ALL ABOUT IT P38](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0038), +3 more</sub>

### [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/norman-douglas--rosemary-west.md)

Norman confronts [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) at the [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) spring to ask that she release her sister, [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md), from a childhood vow so that he and [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) can marry. Although [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) consents to his request, [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) remains hesitant to leave her sister living alone, leaving Norman's prospective status as her brother-in-law uncertain.

- presumed Sibling of — intended brother-in-law by marriage to her sister  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XXXII. TWO STUBBORN PEOPLE P1](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0001)</sub>

### [Wilson](../character/wilson.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/norman-douglas--wilson.md)

[Wilson](../character/wilson.md) serves as Norman's housekeeper at his home. She is present during [Faith](../character/faith.md) Meredith's visits, assisting with domestic affairs such as serving supper when Norman invites [Faith](../character/faith.md) to stay and dine.

- Commands — housekeeper  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P27](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0027)</sub>
